Furthermore, owing to a regulatory requirement, exactly one of the following two connections must be incorporated into the circuit: the link between Warehouse Beta and Gamma, or the link between Warehouse Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed tour that visits each warehouse exactly once and returns to the point of origin.
